title: Master, the Tempest Is Raging
composition: words and music by Mary Ann Baker and Horatio Palmer (1874); both public domain
credit: From The Army and Navy Hymnal; released into the public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: The sky is o'ershadowed with blackness
No shelter or help is nigh
Carest Thou not that we perish
The winds and the waves shall obey Thy will
